title: Backups
description: Every save keeps the version it replaced and every delete keeps the final state, so a bad edit or an accidental delete is one tcms backup:restore away. Records only — uploaded files and images are never copied, so the footprint stays the size of the JSON. Snapshots live in tcms-data/.system/backups/ and survive application updates. This is an undo history, not a site backup: keep backing up tcms-data/.

enable.label: Keep Object History
enable.help: Master switch. When off, saves and deletes write no snapshots. Existing snapshots are left in place and still restore. Sync's pre-overwrite snapshots are unaffected by this setting.

keep.label: Snapshots per Object
keep.help: The newest snapshots each object keeps; older ones are pruned on the next save. Identical consecutive saves do not stack a duplicate. Raise this on a busy editorial site; it only costs the size of the record's JSON per snapshot.

maxAgeDays.label: Maximum Age (days)
maxAgeDays.help: Snapshots older than this are pruned regardless of the count above — one busy afternoon of edits would otherwise evict last week's version, the one you actually wanted. Set to 0 to keep snapshots until the count limit alone removes them.
